windowSemanticAudit.replyObservationScope: Last reply only; the first proof uses its own named verification child and independent grant.
windowSemanticAudit.firstHeadComparisonBoundary: The public record lacks a separate seed event hash. Its literal comparison remains a source assertion and GREEN-cohort fact; no public recomputation is claimed.

eventCadenceSemanticAudit.replyObservationScope: Last independently verified reply only; every earlier proof uses its own query and named child.
eventCadenceSemanticAudit.signedConfigBoundary: The public config pin and source assertion/GREEN cohort retain signature verification; this auditor does not independently verify its signature.
eventCadenceSemanticAudit.maskBoundary: Captured stages are observations. Only appended independent grants have passed verifyReply; absent later stages/grants/final facts are not credited. Root must read actual task errors and classify every first frame and mask.
eventCadenceSemanticAudit.resourceCounts: Derived by the unchanged public-record loops; no fixed child/socket/ledger-owner/test totals.

producerClaimsSemanticAudit.replyObservationScope: Last independently verified reply only; each earlier proof uses its own named query/response verification child and per-grant digest/token/signer facts.
producerClaimsSemanticAudit.firstHeadComparisonBoundary: The public record lacks a separate seed hash. Its exact first-head comparison remains a source assertion and GREEN-cohort fact, not a public recomputation.
producerClaimsSemanticAudit.maskBoundary: Only reached fields and proofs are retained. Stored/requested mismatches on RED are observations; no absent later checkpoint, ledger, reader, final fact or assertion is credited.
producerClaimsSemanticAudit.resourceCounts: Derived by unchanged public loops; no predicted test/child/socket/ledger-owner counts.
